title: Philip Corso sees a Roswell body at Fort Riley
summary: James Fox tells of Philip Corso sees a Roswell body at Fort Riley, about 1947 at Fort Riley, Kansas, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: opened up with the caskets and he saw the body from the Roswell.

plain: James Fox, talking with a podcast host named Jesse Michels, passes on a story from a man named Philip Corso, whose account he ties to a book called The Day After Roswell. Roswell is a town in New Mexico where, some say, a craft from somewhere else crashed in 1947. According to Fox, Corso said that at Fort Riley, an Army post in Kansas, caskets were opened that same year and he saw a body from the Roswell crash. If that were true, it would mean real bodies from the crash passed through Army hands.
